name: Mock Hypervisor Driver
notes: Hardware-free Hypervisor recipe driver for the dynamic-resources integration tests (ADR 0004, issue #32). create_instance names its fake instance deterministically from context HERD_request_id and returns {success, instance_ref, field_data}; destroy_instance is an idempotent acknowledgement. Failure injection via HERD_mock_fail_actions / HERD_mock_raise_actions / HERD_mock_sleep_ms context values (template field defaults for dynamic templates). Not for production use.
